model: Developer blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E: attributable earnings capitalised at cost of equity (engine route), perpetual loans deducted in the equity bridge

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,240,154,132 ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, Other Information note 1, line 3270), which includes the restricted shares held by the incentive-scheme trustee; above the H1 diluted weighted average of 2,211.3m (interim note 10(B)), so no further dilution is added. Held flat. Scrip dividends (FY2025 final HK$0.90 issued at HK$15.16) are non-SBC issuance that substitutes for cash payout; the model capitalises earnings as if fully distributed, so scrip is not modelled as extra dilution.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated cash flow statement share-based payments add-back RMB147.4m (0.11% of revenue); EquityAwardTaxes nil. SBC is already expensed inside profit before tax, which is the capitalised stream, so sbc_pct_path is 0 to avoid charging it twice. House and street bases coincide; band_position is null by construction, not a 0% finding.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are RMB (CNY); the HKEX quote is HKD. fx_rate is CNY->HKD = 1.1724 from the Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X chart API, regularMarketTime 1792188148 (2026-10-16 22:02 UTC). Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by fx_rate into HKD; the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price. No dual listing for a parity check; direction checked against the company's own HKD dividend: FY2025 final HK$0.90 / 1.1724 = RMB0.77 on basic EPS RMB1.58 = 48.6% payout, consistent with the ~50% the board has paid historically. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; refresh it with the price.

reported_balance_sheet_anchors_rmb_m.note: Audit only. The engine's net_debt/total_debt/cash are 0 because the capitalised stream (profit attributable to equity holders) is already after interest (most interest is capitalised into properties under development and released through cost of sales; P&L finance costs were only RMB458m in FY2025) and after NCI. Subtracting net debt again would deduct it twice. 30 June 2026 interim, RMB'000 converted to millions.

inputs.wacc_rationale: The 'wacc' field carries the RMB COST OF EQUITY, not a WACC: the stream is profit attributable to equity holders, after the Group's ~3% blended borrowing cost (bank loans 1.45-2.95%, parent loans 3.67% at H1 FY2026). Built in the flows' currency: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.3 x RMB equity risk premium 6.0% (mature 4.5% + China country premium 1.5%) = 9.6%, plus 1.4pp for what a minority holder cannot discipline or scenario: state-directed land buying, related-party funding terms set by the parent group, and a project structure in which NCI hold 58% of group equity. 11.0% in every scenario; one point above the 10.0% used for COLI (0688.HK), the sector's strongest credit, because C&D is smaller, more NCI-heavy and more parent-dependent. Cyclicality, margin and asset-value risk sit in the scenarios and terminal multiples, so each risk is charged once.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt, immaterial: lease liabilities RMB161.5m at H1 FY2026 against RMB73.6bn of borrowings. Lease interest is already inside profit before tax; no lease charge in the flows and nothing in the bridge.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: cash_tax_rate_path is a combined leakage rate = 1 - (profit attributable to equity holders / profit before tax), i.e. PRC CIT + land appreciation tax, then the NCI share of post-tax profit. History: FY2021 38.1%, FY2022 41.9%, FY2023 41.3%, FY2024 55.8%, FY2025 62.5% (tax 43.1%, NCI 34.1% of post-tax), H1 FY2026 9.4% (tax nil: RMB898m of the RMB911m pre-tax profit was non-taxable share of associates, plus prior-year losses used; NCI 9.3%). FY2023-25 pooled 53.8%. Base 50% FY2026 (low-leakage H1 already banked) then 52%. No NCI deduction in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 revenue 136,788.5 x PBT margin 7.12% x (1 - 62.5%) = RMB3,650.6m attributable = last_fcf.
inputs.perpetual_treatment: Perpetual loans from C&D Real Estate (parent group), RMB10.0bn at 30 June 2026 (RMB12.0bn at FY2025; RMB2.0bn repaid in H1 FY2026, RMB2.5bn in FY2023). Their distributions are deducted from retained earnings, NOT from profit attributable to equity holders (FY2025 AR note 11: 3,650.6 attributable less 467.7 distributions = 3,182.9 used for EPS). The stream therefore still contains the perpetual holder's claim, so the RMB10.0bn is deducted at face in equity_bridge, as a floating-rate (5yr LPR) instrument whose 3pp step-up at the 10-year date (Dec 2030 / Jun 2031) makes redemption at face the expected outcome. Charging both the distribution in the flows and the face in the bridge would double count; this build does only the latter.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Developer blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E (dcf-methods SKILL.md routing row 'Land subdivider, inventory-heavy developer'), run through the Drivers engine with net debt at zero, the same route and engine mapping as the sector peer 0688.HK (COLI) so the two are comparable. First valuation of 1908.HK (no MEMORY entry). WHY NOT OWNER-FCF: reported FCF swings from RMB-11.7bn (FY2017) to +24.2bn (FY2023) to +3.5bn (FY2024) to +21.6bn (FY2025) on the timing of land payments and pre-sale receipts; it is a cycle-position signal, not a value. EV less RMB21bn net debt, RMB55bn NCI and RMB10bn perpetuals would also deduct financing the earnings stream already carries. WHY NOT A NAV/ASSET WATERFALL: the company is not distressed (SOE-backed, net debt/equity fell to 22% at H1 FY2026, RMB61.8bn cash, borrowing cost ~3%); a going-concern earnings model is appropriate, with asset value entering through the exit-P/B leg of the terminal. ENGINE MAPPING: base_revenue = FY2025 revenue; 'ebitda_margin_path' = PROFIT BEFORE TAX margin (after finance costs, fair-value movements and share of associates/JVs; FY2021 10.6%, FY2022 8.5%, FY2023 6.4%, FY2024 7.6%, FY2025 7.1%); SBC/lease/D&A/capex paths 0 and wc_capture 0 so EBIT = pre-tax profit; 'cash_tax_rate_path' = combined tax + NCI leakage, so NOPAT = profit attributable to equity holders (before perpetual distributions), discounted at the 11% RMB cost of equity. last_fcf is FY2025 attributable profit RMB3,650.6m, not owner FCF; reported_fcf is kept for the record. wc_capture is 0 rather than a negative equity-retention charge because the near-term revenue declines would otherwise book phantom capital releases; retention is instead reflected in the low terminal growth and exit multiples. TERMINAL = the blend, entered as terminal_cap_multiple on year-10 attributable earnings; see each scenario's terminal_rationale. Buybacks: none (buyback_cash 0); the count is flat by construction, and scrip take-up will in practice add ~2-4% a year to shares.
inputs.historical_growth_notes: Revenue and equity CAGRs describe the 2018-2023 land-bank build-out funded by parent loans, rights issues and scrip, not a forward rate; EPS has fallen 18%/yr over three years as margins compressed and the share count rose from 1.62bn to 2.24bn. Owner-FCF CAGRs (+102% 3y) are pre-sale timing noise.

equity_bridge.item: Perpetual loans from C&D Real Estate (parent group) at face
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet / reserves note: RMB10.0bn outstanding at 30 June 2026 after a RMB2.0bn repayment; distributions are charged to retained earnings below profit attributable to equity holders (FY2025 AR note 11), so the claim is still inside the capitalised stream.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case terminal growth. Equity CAGR (29.3% 5y) is the house primary but reflects share issuance and parent-funded expansion into a market now shrinking; using it would be meaningless here.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5y CAGR 29.3% vs EPS 5y CAGR -3.6% and revenue 3y 11.1% vs H1 FY2026 revenue -48%: book grew on new equity and retained earnings while per-share earnings fell. Not used.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs FY2022->FY2025 (3y) and FY2020->FY2025 (5y). EPS is basic RMB EPS (kpis EPSBasic: FY2025 1.58, FY2022 2.84, FY2020 1.90). Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2025 21,021.5, FY2022 2,568.0, FY2020 3,950.1. The owner-FCF CAGR exceeds the reported-FCF trend only because FY2022 was a land-heavy trough; SBC (0.1% of revenue) is immaterial either way.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -22% (~RMB107bn): H1 delivered RMB17.8bn and contract liabilities rose to RMB158.8bn at 30 June 2026; H2 revenue has run at 0.52-0.56x of the June contract-liability balance (H2 FY2024 110.2/213.3, H2 FY2025 102.6/184.4), implying ~RMB83-89bn in H2. FY2027 -6% and FY2028 -2%: handovers recognise contracted sales 1-2 years later, and attributable contracted sales fell 12.0% in FY2025 and 8.4% in H1 FY2026. Then +1-2% as FY2025-26 land (41 projects, ~RMB130bn saleable value) and the 'second curve' (property management/construction services, +26% in H1 FY2026, 14% of H1 revenue) offset a national market Fitch still sees shrinking.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin 6.0% in FY2026 (H1 FY2026 5.1%, of which almost all was associate profit; FY2025 7.1%), 6.5-7.5% FY2027-29, 8.0% from FY2030 as land bought after 2022 (~83% of the reserve by value) is delivered: H1 FY2026 gross margin was 14.3% vs 12.9% a year earlier. 8% is the FY2022 level and below FY2021's 10.6%; selling-expense intensity stays high in a buyer's market.
base.leakage_rationale: 50% FY2026 because H1 leakage was 9% (non-taxable associate profit, losses used); 52% thereafter, between the FY2021-23 ~40% and FY2024-25 ~59%, as LAT normalises with margins and the NCI share of a project book in which NCI hold 58% of equity stays high.
base.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 6.5x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.60x / year-10 ROE ~9% = 6.6x) = 6.5x. Year-10 book ~RMB47bn (30.2bn today plus ~50% retention of RMB3-4bn/yr). Exit P/E 6.5x is mid of the 5-8x SOE developers have traded at since 2022. Gordon at 11%/1% = 10.1x, so the cap binds.

bull.growth_rationale: FY2026 -15%: H2 conversion at the top of the historical range (~0.6x of June contract liabilities) as the September-onward launches Citi flagged sell through. Flat FY2027 and +4-5% FY2028-29 as the accelerated FY2025-26 land buying converts and SOE share gains outrun the national decline; 3% thereafter.
bull.margin_rationale: Post-2022 land at mid-teens gross margins plus a falling ~3% funding cost lift pre-tax margin to 9.5% by FY2030, still below FY2021's 10.6%.
bull.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 8.5x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.95x / year-10 ROE ~11% = 8.6x) = 8.5x, roughly where state-backed developers traded in 2020-21. Gordon at 11%/2% = 11.3x; cap binds.

bear.growth_rationale: FY2026 -28%: H2 conversion at ~0.5x of June contract liabilities with handover delays. Contracted sales keep falling ~8-12% a year as in FY2025 and H1 FY2026, so revenue shrinks to ~RMB70bn by FY2030 and stops there: the 'no bottom' path Fitch's 2026 forecast leaves open.
bear.margin_rationale: Further price discounting and inventory impairments hold pre-tax margin at 4.5-5%, the FY2023 low less the gross-margin pressure seen industry-wide.
bear.leakage_rationale: 57%: LAT eases with margins but the NCI share of a smaller profit pool rises toward FY2025's 34% of post-tax and beyond.
bear.terminal_rationale: Blend: 0.5 x exit P/E 5.0x + 0.5 x (exit P/B 0.30x on a book held near RMB30bn by impairments / year-10 ROE ~5% = 6.0x) = 5.5x. Gordon at 11%/0% = 9.1x; cap binds.

scenario_narratives.base: Survive and consolidate at low margins. Handovers from the weaker 2024-25 sales cohort cut revenue ~22% in FY2026 and a further 8% over FY2027-28, then the post-2022 land bank (higher gross margin, core-city weighted) and SOE share gains from defaulted private peers stabilise revenue around RMB100-110bn. Pre-tax margin recovers to 8% and roughly half of it leaks to tax, LAT and project partners, leaving RMB3-4bn a year for equity holders. Parent funding stays available and cheap; the perpetual loans are redeemed at face around their 2030-31 step-up.
scenario_narratives.bull: The state-backed funding advantage and flagship-project product turn into share: September-2026 launches sell through, contracted sales return to growth by FY2028, the property-management/construction 'second curve' keeps compounding, and funding costs keep falling. Margin reaches 9.5% and the market re-rates SOE developers toward 2020-21 multiples (~8.5x earnings, ~0.95x book). Needs a stabilising national market and margin expansion and a re-rating together, which is why it carries 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: No bottom. National new-home sales keep falling, C&D's contracted sales keep declining 8-12% a year as in FY2025 and H1 FY2026, and selling costs and impairments hold pre-tax margin near 5%. Revenue settles ~RMB70bn, the NCI share of a shrinking profit pool rises, and the market prices the sector at ~5x earnings and 0.3x book. The parent keeps the company solvent, so this is a value case, not a credit event; the risk that the parent's own balance sheet or an SOE deleveraging directive tightens the RMB38bn loan line sits here.
scenario_narratives.base_note: First build; no prior version to reconcile.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (up from the 15% default): the market has no confirmed bottom, C&D's attributable contracted sales have fallen in consecutive periods, H1 FY2026 revenue halved, and >50% of debt plus the perpetuals depend on one parent group. Base 50%: survive-and-consolidate at low margins is the central path for an SOE-backed developer whose net debt fell to RMB21bn in H1 FY2026. Bull 20% (down from 35%): it needs market stabilisation, margin expansion on new land and a sector re-rating to happen together. Same 30/50/20 as COLI (0688.HK), the sector's best credit, for cross-ticker comparability.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A Chinese residential developer's value is the after-tax, after-minority earnings it can distribute through the cycle plus what its book is worth at exit, not an unlevered FCF that swings by tens of billions with land and pre-sale timing. The stream is profit attributable to equity holders at the RMB cost of equity, net debt held at zero because interest is already in the stream, the RMB10bn of parent-group perpetual loans deducted at face, and a terminal that blends an exit P/E with an exit P/B on year-10 book.
key_risks_to_valuation: Revenue path rests on the contract-liability-to-handover conversion ratio (0.52-0.56x historically); a delivery slip moves FY2026 by RMB10bn+.
Leakage (tax + LAT + NCI) has ranged 38-63% of pre-tax profit; every 5pp is ~10% of value.
Parent-group dependency: RMB38.0bn of parent loans and RMB10.0bn of perpetual loans; a change in parent willingness or an SOE deleveraging directive would hit funding cost and liquidity.
Mortgage guarantees (RMB19bn at FY2025) and NCI receivables (RMB40.2bn due from NCI at H1 FY2026) are not charged in the model.
fx_rate (CNY->HKD 1.1724) is not moved by refresh_price.py; a 5% RMB move is a 5% move in HKD value.
Scrip dividends grow the share count ~2-4% a year in practice; the model holds it flat because earnings are capitalised as if fully distributed.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range HK$11.47-18.47.
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X chart API, regularMarketTime 1792188148.
data_sources.financials: 1908.HK_Metrics.csv and kpis (FY2017-FY2025 annuals, H1 FY2023-FY2026 interims); FY2025 Annual Report income statement, balance sheet, EPS note 11 and perpetual-loan note 33; H1 FY2026 Interim Report statements, EPS note 10, MD&A (contracted sales, gross margin, net debt, borrowing rates).
